# Defaults study: results (generated by defaults_summary.R)

SILM 2.0.0; R R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24), SILM 2.0.0, glmnet 5.1, lars 1.3, MASS 7.3.65; M = 500, B = 499; replications per cell: zc = 200, sr = 200, st = 200, dbz = 100; 40 shards, 54.9 CPU-hours.

## Decisions (rules of DEFAULTS.md)

* **nodewise** (cv vs ZnZ; 236 units): calibration shortfall 0.1005 vs 0.0531 (difference -0.0473, 95% bootstrap interval [-0.0507, -0.0443]); mean power 0.594 vs 0.610 (difference 0.016, [0.011, 0.020]). **Decision: use 'ZnZ'.**
  * sr | cv | power: 24 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) 0.0978
  * st | cv | error: 6 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) -0.0050
  * st | cv | power: 6 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) -0.0683

  * zc | cv | power: 40 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) -0.0210
* **robust.divisor** (n vs n-s; 67 units): calibration shortfall 0.0547 vs 0.0305 (difference -0.0242, 95% bootstrap interval [-0.0281, -0.0183]); mean power 0.701 vs 0.674 (difference -0.027, [-0.032, -0.023]). **Decision: use 'n-s'.**
  * dbz | asym/cv/n | coverage: 13 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) -0.0161
  * dbz | asym/cv/n | error: 7 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) -0.0771

  * dbz | boot/shortcut/n | power: 6 units, mean difference (candidate - current; shortfall for calibration, level for power) -0.0259
